== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Steel is a versatile substance and a form of power that can be summoned or manipulated. It exists as a physical material used to forge various objects, ranging from delicate masks and padlocks to massive war-hammers and swords. A specific, rare variety known as [[Tartarus steel]] is characterized by its mirror-like brightness and near-indestructible properties. While this premium metal can easily pierce standard metals, it is strong enough to withstand strikes from other [[Tartarus steel]] weapons. Beyond physical objects, steel can be summoned as a magical force or essence. Users can call upon it to manifest weapons, transform their own skin into [[stone]]-like armor, or create large [[constructs]] such as giants and [[spiders]]. This power can be drawn out gradually or summoned all at once, though it is a finite resource that can be exhausted during use.}}
